pairs.ideal_answer: Within 72 hours of their start date.

pairs.question: vpn drops every hour fix
pairs.ideal_answer: Session timeout defaults to 3600s; raise it via IT.
evidence_texts:
## Troubleshooting VPN
Symptom: connection drops every hour. Fix: the
        session timeout defaults to 3600s; ask IT to raise it for your group.
Symptom: DNS resolves but no traffic. Fix: check
        that split-tunnel routes include the corp subnets, not just DNS.
Symptom: auth rejected. Fix: re-enroll the token;
        expired MFA registrations cause silent rejections.

移行は3段階で行います。まずスキーマをエクスポートし、

        最大5分を想定してください。
